_doc: Colour override for the two lower volumes of the Sint-Janstoren complex (GRB 4600899, 44 m, and 4601992, 39 m, just south of the main tower 363006 whose massing.json is next to this file): white render walls and a green roof garden, as on the Commons photos (k-in-kortrijk/refs). The polygon is a 31 x 14 m box in Lambert 72 around their centres.
